aiOverview.content: The College Basketball Crown (CBC) is a new annual postseason men's basketball tournament launched in 2025 by FOX Sports and AEG. Held in Las Vegas, it features top-performing teams from major conferences (Big Ten, Big 12, Big East) that did not qualify for the NCAA Tournament, offering a $500,000 NIL prize pool. NIL prize pool Key Details of the College Basketball Crown: Tournament Structure: The 2026 tournament features an 8-team, single-elimination format, held from April 1–5 in Las Vegas, with games at the T-Mobile Arena and MGM Grand Garden Arena. T-Mobile Arena MGM Grand Garden Arena Participants: The tournament showcases teams from major conferences like the Big 12, Big Ten, and BIG EAST, along with at-large selections that just missed the NCAA Tournament. Prize Money: The tournament focuses on Name, Image, and Likeness (NIL) prizes, featuring a $500,000 total prize pool for players. Inaugural Winner: The Nebraska Cornhuskers won the first tournament in 2025. Nebraska Cornhuskers Media Coverage: All games are broadcast on FOX and FS1. This tournament is designed to compete with the National Invitation Tournament (NIT) as a premier alternative postseason destination.
